name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (Ayushman Bharat)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health insurance scheme providing health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization. It covers over 10.74 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 50 crore beneficiaries). The scheme is entirely paperless and cashless at government and empanelled private hospitals.

custom_criteria.secc_database: Family must be in SECC-2011 database
custom_criteria.deprivation_criteria: Must meet deprivation criteria or belong to listed occupational category

benefits.description: Health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospitalization. Covers 1,393 medical procedures including surgeries, medical treatments, day care, pre and post hospitalization expenses. Entirely cashless and paperless at all empanelled hospitals. No cap on family size or age. Pre-existing diseases covered from day one

documents_required.name: Mobile Number
documents_required.description: Active mobile number for OTP verification

steps: Check eligibility on Ayushman Bharat portal using mobile number
If eligible, visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Ayushman Mitra
Provide Aadhaar card and mobile number
Hospital verifies eligibility and provides cashless treatment

success_stories: ₹60,000+ crore worth of treatment given free
